purpose: Prioritize confident reference appearance among already screened G0 packets; no new detection or pose fitting
chosen_after_observing: First 80 candidate first-frame contacts and cached-mask diagnostics, before any extra DiT generation
interpretation: Engineering priority, not paper thresholds or proof of quality. Low-scoring tracks remain available; brief later occlusion is not a universal rejection. Previously visually verified/repaired demos are reviewed explicitly.
accessory_rule: Inspect actual observed-versus-masked appearance before approval; missing carried objects require repair or a different already-screened candidate, not painting over them.
